g.title: Exploration
g.desc: Inventory: top-left rounded base frame contains title, source Dafny code card, three small example cards, arrows into an LLM network icon, arrow into a verifier icon, and three translation cards labeled Invalid, Unverified, Verified. Layout is left-to-right pipeline with example/source inputs converging on the origin LLM, then verifier, then branching to translations.

g.title: Treefinement
g.desc: Inventory: top-right rounded base frame contains title, an unverified program card, a small examples stack, blue branching tree of candidate nodes, a program-plus-errors panel feeding a refine LLM box, and final verified code card. Whole section is a left-to-right tree refinement process, with a symmetric tree branching around a central horizontal axis.

g.title: Self-Improvement
g.desc: Inventory: bottom-left rounded base frame contains title and three training-data rows: new translation examples, new correction examples, and new exploit examples. Each row has a cluster of small example cards, a right-pointing arrow, and a corresponding improvement label. Structure uses three horizontal parallel lanes.

g.title: Critique
g.desc: Inventory: bottom-right rounded base frame contains title, a verified code card feeding through an arrow to three critique method boxes labeled Comparison, Exploit, and Rule-based, then another arrow to a larger verified and aligned code card. The three middle boxes form a vertical stack aligned to a common left edge.
